descripcionAnterior:
Seasonal cooking in the heart of Antigua Guatemala. Our menu changes with what the garden gives and what nearby producers bring, so there is always something new to try. This is the full menu, with current prices.
It includes starters, healthy options, burgers, main courses, sides, coffee and house drinks, our signature cocktail list and the wine list. If you would rather see it at the table, the same menu is printed at the restaurant.
